summary: The diff implements Uint8Array.prototype.setFromBase64 in full, in spec order. ValidateUint8Array (step 2), the String check (3), GetOptionsObject and the alphabet and lastChunkHandling reads and validation (4-10), ValidateTypedArrayBounds (11), TypedArrayLength (12), FromBase64 via the existing helpers (13-15), the Assert (17), SetUint8ArrayBytes (18), the deferred error throw (19), and the result object with read and written (20-23) are all present. Errors propagate with ?, nothing is swallowed, and no value is made up. There are no test-shaped branches. The only unrequested change is renaming the new_target parameter to _new_target, which is needed to avoid an unused-variable warning. The two spec steps 5-7 and 8-10 are grouped under paraphrased comments rather than verbatim step text, which is a style deviation from CLAUDE.md, not a behavioural defect. The helper signatures in from_base64.rs and the typed_array helpers were not in the diff, so I could not verify them, but the gate reports build and clippy as ok.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. Optional style fix: steps 5-7 and 8-10 are combined under paraphrased comments; CLAUDE.md asks for each step's spec text as its own comment directly above the code.
